name: Vaisala Oyj
summary: Vaisala Oyj provides weather, environmental, and industrial measurement for weather and industrial markets in North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It offers Origo, a modular HVAC transmitters; Vaisala Circular, a probe recalibration and reuse service; Elements Lite for weather intelligence; and WindCube 2.1 XP that delivers wind resource data.
